messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=redwood-inference-apac-east p99 latency > 900ms (current p99=1250ms) over 5m window. Trigger=latency_slo_burn. Paging @maria_oncall

maria_oncall: Ack. I'm on it — pulling dashboards and traces now.

maria_oncall: Looks regional (apac-east only). Hot path shows tokenizer queueing + long tail on model worker GC. LB queue depth ~50% higher, token-service 5xx ~3%

samir: Can confirm tokenizer backlog spike. I can probe sidecar logs, might be a batching regression.

samir: Running quick query on sidecar metrics: `sum(rate(sidecar_batch_latency_seconds[1m])) by (host)` — seeing a few hosts with 5-10x baseline.

kelly: I'm going to prime the KV/prefix cache for the busiest routes. Launching warmup job now.

maria_oncall: While we dig, let's do two mitigations: 1) scale pool apac-east +2 GPUs, 2) route new low-latency traffic to fallback model variant (rwlm-small-quant) for APAC via routing policy. Anyone object?

dan_ops: No objection. Scaling now: ```infractl scale --pool apac-east --delta 2 --reason "p99 spike"``` Ops ticket created.

ops-bot: Scale task queued (task id: scale-8791). Estimated completion 60-90s.

maria_oncall: Samir, can you trigger model fallthrough? Use policy `region-fallthrough: apac-east -> rwlm-small-quant`. Keep 10% traffic for canary.

samir: Triggering rollout: `routerctl apply --policy region-fallthrough --region apac-east --variant rwlm-small-quant --canary 10`

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by maria_oncall. Escalation suppressed for 10m while mitigating.

maria_oncall: customer-impact: short-lived text generations for a subset of PLG customers returned slow (timeouts) around the spike window. Early estimate: ~2% requests affected, mostly <60s windows. Not seeing errors in embeddings.

michelle_se: Notifying support on impacted product lines and drafting a small status blurb for customers if this persists.

kelly: KV warmup job done — warmed top 5k keys for apac routes. Cold-starts observed drop by ~30%.

ops-bot: Scale task completed. Added 2 GPUs to pool apac-east. Pool healthy.

samir: After rollout, observed p99 drop from 1250ms -> ~880ms in APAC within 2 mins. Canary 10% healthy.

maria_oncall: Good. Continue monitoring for 15m. If p99 < 800ms and stable, we'll keep fallback in place for 30m then roll back. If not, escalate to ENG-SRE PD.

samir: I'll keep an eye on sidecar hosts flagged earlier; collecting logs for a later postmortem. Uploading to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/8801122334/sidecar-logs.tar.gz

kelly: Confirming: KV cold-starts reduced, prefix cache hit-rate up +22%.

maria_oncall: Current metrics: p95=210ms, p99=720ms, SLO burn 5% over last 10m. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/latency/apac-east?orgId=1

maria_oncall: Handing off in 18m to @michelle_se (shift change). TL;DR: regional apac-east p99 spike caused by tokenizer/sidecar batching regression + insufficient pool capacity. Mitigations applied: scaled pool +2, model fallthrough to rwlm-small-quant (10% canary -> healthy), KV warmup. Impact low but tracked.

michelle_se: Taking over. I'll keep monitoring and decide on permanent actions (auto-scaler tuning, model variant defaults) if the anomaly recurs. Please attach runbook link for handoff.

maria_oncall: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/latency-p99. Postmortem owner: @samir.

michelle_se: Received. I'll also open a ticket to evaluate autoscaler thresholds and investigate batching regression with runtime team.

maria_oncall: One last note — if PD fires again and p99 > 1000ms, escalate immediately and add ENG-ML and runtime oncall to the bridge. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert still active? current p99=700ms (stable). No new pages in the last 5m.

michelle_se: Great — keeping this thread pinned for the handoff notes. Will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
